title: PlayerEmbed: Learning Behavioral Fingerprint Representations from Raw Input Sequences
abstract: arXiv:2610.32727v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Raw player input sequences in video games contain fine-grained behavior, but are high-dimensional and noisy, which makes large-scale analytics challenging. To address this, we introduce PlayerEmbed, a framework that learns compact and discriminative player embeddings using deep metric learning. Our approach uses a hybrid CNN-LSTM encoder trained on raw input sequences from 1,000 players. We evaluate the model on held-out sequences from these players and on sequences from 1,000 players entirely unseen during training to assess generalization to unseen identities. For player identification, a nearest-centroid classifier built from reference embeddings achieves strong performance, reaching balanced accuracies of 0.950 for players seen during training and 0.879 for players unseen during training. translated_title: PlayerEmbed：从原始输入序列中学习行为指纹表示
translated_abstract: 电子游戏中的原始玩家输入序列包含细粒度的行为信息，但其高维和噪声特性使得大规模分析充满挑战。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了PlayerEmbed，一个利用深度度量学习来学习紧凑且具有判别性的玩家嵌入表示的框架。我们的方法采用混合CNN-LSTM编码器，在来自1,000名玩家的原始输入序列上进行训练。我们在这些玩家的保留序列上，以及在来自训练期间完全未见过的1,000名玩家的序列上对模型进行评估，以检验其对未见身份的泛化能力。在玩家识别任务中，基于参考嵌入构建的最近质心分类器取得了强劲性能，对训练期间见过的玩家达到0.950的平衡准确率，对训练期间未见过的玩家达到0.879的平衡准确率。系统性增加训练玩家数量能够显著提升对未见玩家的泛化能力，表明从……
tldr: 该论文提出PlayerEmbed框架，利用深度度量学习和混合CNN-LSTM编码器从原始玩家输入序列中学习紧凑的行为指纹嵌入，在玩家识别任务中对已见和未见玩家分别达到0.950和0.879的平衡准确率，且增加训练玩家数量可显著提升对未见玩家的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces PlayerEmbed, a deep metric learning framework with a hybrid CNN-LSTM encoder that learns compact behavioral fingerprint embeddings from raw player input sequences, achieving balanced accuracies of 0.950 and 0.879 for seen and unseen players in identification, with more training players substantially improving generalization to unseen identities.
